wikipedia.title: Desert Wind Farm
wikipedia.extract: The Desert Wind Farm, also known as Amazon Wind Farm US East, spans Perquimans and Pasquotank County on the Atlantic coastal plain in northeast North Carolina.   With a total generating capacity of 208 megawatts (MW), it became the first large wind farm in the southeast United States when it came online at the end of 2016.  All of the electricity is contracted to Amazon to power its growing data centers in Virginia and the region.
